# Zitrone

> Zitrone designs and operates workplace food programs in Mexico: corporate dining rooms (comedor corporativo), corporate cafés, pantry and snack restocking, office coffee and water service, grab-and-go, and corporate catering. Site content is available in Spanish (default) and English.

## Services (Spanish)

- [Comedor corporativo](https://www.zitrone.mx/es/services/comedor-corporativo): design and operation of on-site corporate dining
- [Cafetería corporativa](https://www.zitrone.mx/es/services/cafeteria-corporativa): staffed café service for workplaces
- [Pantry y restocking](https://www.zitrone.mx/es/services/pantry-y-restocking): pantry supply and snack restocking
- [Café y agua](https://www.zitrone.mx/es/services/cafe-y-agua): office coffee and water dispenser service
- [Grab and go](https://www.zitrone.mx/es/services/grab-and-go): ready-to-eat meals and snacks to take away
- [Catering corporativo](https://www.zitrone.mx/es/services/catering-corporativo): corporate event catering
